test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All trees are greens.

Some trees are conifers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All conifers are greens.

II. Some greens are trees.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a538050c1d032cb20999cce34b8581679b9747becf75a4d2da8a901028d468ab.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All conifers are greens → Does not follow (As all trees are greens and some trees are conifers. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some greens are trees → Follow (As some trees are conifers. As some part of trees is common with conifers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
